The '''Income''' (Japanese: '''インカム''' ''Income'') is a headset device that allows [[Shu]] to talk to his {{TP|Shu|Pikachu}}. It is only seen in the {{pkmn|manga}} [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]].

In the manga, the main character Shu is the only character to own an Income. It was invented by his {{TP|Shu|father}} and he himself does not know how well it works.

Similarly, the character {{GDZ|Masatoshi}} is able to communicate with his {{p|Meowth}} through a "Cat Cap", a hood with two Meowth ears.
